Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the cemetery setting, add a concrete action showing what Mengzi copies: “孟子学着大人弯腰祭拜。”
2. At “跟朋友聊天,” add a small feeling or spoken line to show why he enjoys the place: “他觉得这里很有趣。”
3. After “都很小,” add a detail about the city’s atmosphere to make the contrast clearer: “街上每天都有很多商人卖东西。”

ideas.reason: It gives a concrete, story-appropriate action showing what Mengzi does near the cemetery.
The learner already says that he likes the city, so saying it is interesting adds little new information.
Merchants and market activity belong to the later market setting after the family moves, not this cemetery scene.
